uri.description: Broker URI including scheme and port, e.g. mqtt://broker.local:1883

username.description: Broker username; empty for an anonymous connection

client_id.description: MQTT client identifier; empty uses the device name passed to mqtt_manager_start()

topic_prefix.description: Root topic for everything published and subscribed. '$DEVICE$' is replaced with the device name, so one configuration can serve a fleet.

keepalive_s.description: Keepalive interval; the broker declares the client dead after roughly 1.5x this

lwt_suffix.description: Topic under the prefix carrying the online/offline state. Empty disables the last will.

lwt_offline.description: Payload the broker publishes when the client stops responding

lwt_qos.description: QoS for the birth and will messages
